verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Crude spike lifts integrated majors over E&Ps
cells.refutation: Integrated-vs-EP relative return from t+1 open to close shows no positive response to crude shocks.
cells.separation_from_beta: Long XOM/CVX vs short FANG,OXY,DVN spread is positive after crude shocks; both legs share energy beta so XLE-hedge nets it out.

cells.title: Tanker rates read through to refiners' crude sourcing cost
cells.refutation: Refiner basket open-to-close t+1 move is indistinguishable from XLE-hedged control after a tanker shock.
cells.separation_from_beta: Effect persists after hedging XLE and SPY; only refiners with high import share (VLO, PBF, DINO) react, not domestic-heavy ones.

cells.title: Yield spike -> homebuilders lag
cells.refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect
cells.separation_from_beta: same-day beta printed apart; lag residual after SPY beta
